name: headroom
purpose: Use actual reversible compression and exact retrieval while preserving provider/account routing.

criteria.description: Verify an actual supported Headroom runtime rather than copied file presence.
Retain recoverable original context and explicit retrieval identity.
Retrieve exact content where required and preserve provider/account routing.

limits: Mechanical verification checks recorded facts and actual retained bytes; a recorded semantic inspection is not authenticated judgment.
Compilation and fixture success do not prove complete semantic workflow performance or provider/native-host activation.
Actual provider/runtime access is required for execution. Verification does not start a provider job, proxy or account session.
The deterministic core does not start a proxy/compressor or authenticate reversibility. Exercise the actual runtime and original-context retrieval.
